title: Tenaris presents the TenarisHydril White™ connection at ADIPEC
summary: Building on the technological success of the TenarisHydril Blue® and Wedge™ Series connections, the White™ connection combines advanced engineering and manufacturing innovation in a connection designed for the future of well construction. The connection is designed to perform in the most complex applications, including deepwater, HP/HT, horizontal and extended-reach wells where reliability and operational consistency are critical.

PUBLISHED ON 11/02/2026


Tenaris has unveiled the TenarisHydril White™ connection, the company's latest innovation in premium threaded and coupled connections. Introduced at ADIPEC in Abu Dhabi, the new connection builds on the proven performance of TenarisHydril technologies, delivering enhanced strength, best-in-class sealability, and improved efficiency for challenging offshore and complex drilling applications.


"The development of the TenarisHydril White™ connection reflects our commitment to helping customers meet the increasing demands of today's energy landscape," said **Gabriel Podskubka,** Tenaris Chief Executive Officer. "By combining our technical expertise with close customer collaboration, we continue to develop solutions that support the safe and efficient delivery of energy around the world."


The connection features best-in-class sealability and category-leading torque capacity. Available in a wide range of sizes, the connection is engineered to deliver reliable performance for offshore and other complex drilling applications. Its slim-coupling design facilitates deployment in deviated wells and improves cementing efficiency.


With performance enabled by Dopeless® technology, the TenarisHydril White™ connection enhances safety and improves operational efficiency. With no need for field-applied thread compounds, Dopeless® technology reduces preparation time, improves runnability, and is environmentally friendly with zero discharge. The connection has also been designed for automated, human-less casing installation, removing the need for personnel to work directly in high-risk “red zone” areas on the rig floor.


"The TenarisHydril White™ connection represents a significant advance in premium connection technology," said **Lucas Pigliacampo,** Tenaris Chief Technology Officer. "We have developed a connection that helps operators succeed in complex applications, including deepwater, high-pressure, high-temperature wells, and horizontal & extended-reach wells."


[Learn more about TenarisHydril White™](https://www.tenaris.com/en/products-and-services/octg/white)


**Frequently asked questions**


**What is the TenarisHydril White™ connection?**


The TenarisHydril White™ connection expands the TenarisHydril premium connection portfolio, engineered to help operators improve well integrity, operational efficiency, and running performance in increasingly complex well environments. Building on the proven performance of TenarisHydril technologies, the connection combines exceptional structural strength, advanced sealing performance, and simplified deployment in a single connection.


**What are the main features of the connection?**


The TenarisHydril White™ connection combines best-in-class sealability, category-leading torque capacity, a slim-coupling design, compatibility with automated rig operations, and integrated Dopeless® technology. Together, these features support reliable well construction, improved running efficiency, and consistent performance across a range of drilling applications.


**What are the benefits of the TenarisHydril White™ connection?**


The TenarisHydril White™ connection helps operators improve safety, efficiency, and reliability in challenging well conditions. Designed for offshore, deepwater, HPHT, and extended-reach applications, it supports faster, more consistent operations, reduces personnel exposure to high-risk rig-floor activities, and helps enhance well integrity. By enabling efficient installation and reliable performance in demanding environments, the connection can help operators reduce operational risk and improve overall well construction performance.


**What applications is the TenarisHydril White™ connection designed for?**


The TenarisHydril White™ connection is designed for challenging well environments where reliability, efficiency, and well integrity are critical. It is well suited for offshore and deepwater operations, high-pressure/high-temperature (HPHT) wells, horizontal wells, extended-reach wells, and other complex drilling applications. Its design helps operators meet the demands of technically challenging projects while supporting safe and efficient well construction.


**How does the connection improve well integrity?**


The TenarisHydril White™ connection is engineered to deliver best-in-class sealing performance and exceptional structural reliability, helping operators maintain well integrity throughout the life of the well. Its performance has been validated beyond the industry's most demanding testing requirements, providing confidence in challenging applications such as HPHT (HP/HT), deepwater, and horizontal & extended-reach wells.


**Why does the TenarisHydril White™ connection have a slim coupling?**


While maintaining full pipe-body structural efficiency, the slim-coupling design facilitates deployment in complex well architectures, including highly deviated and extended-reach wells. It also supports improved cementing efficiency and operational flexibility, helping operators optimize well construction while maintaining high levels of performance and reliability.


**Is the TenarisHydril White™ connection suitable for modern automated rig operations?**


Yes. The TenarisHydril White™ connection is specifically built for automated rig operations. Its robust design and running characteristics support safer execution, operational consistency, and improved efficiency while reducing dependence on manual intervention with personnel exposure in the “red zone.”


**Does the TenarisHydril White™ connection use Dopeless® technology?**


Yes. Dopeless® technology is a Tenaris innovation integrated directly into the connection's design to unlock a higher performance. Without the need for conventional thread compounds, Dopeless® technology simplifies pipe handling, improves running efficiency, supports cleaner operations, and reduces environmental impact while maintaining reliable connection performance.


**What differentiates the TenarisHydril White™ connection from other premium connections?**


The connection combines exceptional sealability, category-leading torque performance, automated-rig compatibility, a streamlined coupling design, and integrated Dopeless® technology in a single connection. Developed to address the evolving needs of modern well construction, it helps operators improve well integrity, operational efficiency, and running performance without compromise.


**Does TenarisHydril White™ replace Blue® Series or Wedge™ Series connections?**


No. Blue® Series and Wedge™ Series connections remain field-proven solutions for a wide range of applications, including deepwater and HP/HT wells, and continue to be available to our customers. TenarisHydril White™ is the latest addition to the TenarisHydril portfolio and introduces a new connection design combining best-in-class sealability, category-leading torque capacity and enhanced runnability, helping operators improve well integrity and operational efficiency. Operators planning their next wells can work with Tenaris representatives to identify where White™ adds value alongside the connections they already use.
